name: mern-thinkboard
description: MERN Thinkboard is a premium, full-stack notes management application. It serves as a dashboard where users can perform complete **CRUD operations** (Create, Read, Update, Delete) on notes. The project features automated **Rate Limiting** backed by Redis to prevent spamming and slow down API requests under load, complete with custom UI fallback states.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
